milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task where the player must navigate near the yellow terracotta and face it to demonstrate they have found it. The target is the center of the 3-wide, 3-tall yellow terracotta wall at spawn-relative (0, 1, 8). max_distance=5 requires the player to actually walk close to the block (it's 8 blocks from spawn, so they must cover at least 3 blocks), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the yellow terracotta (confirming visual identification rather than just wandering nearby).
